# Project Guidelines

## Commit and merge workflow

- When asked to commit and push changes in this repository, push a topic branch and create a pull request targeting `main`; do not push directly to `main`.
- Follow `.github/pull_request_template.md` exactly and report the results of relevant checks.
- After checks pass, merge the pull request into `main` so the change is included in the default branch. If required checks fail or cannot be run, explain the blocker and ask before merging.
- Confirm the commit is reachable from `main` before saying it should appear in GitHub contribution activity.
